tagline.en: Hosted access to Kling's text-to-video and image-to-video generation, via your own API key.
tagline.zh: 以自备 API key 的方式接入 Kling 的文生视频与图生视频生成服务。

en: Kling API is a hosted video-generation service that WorldFoundry exposes through its Studio pipeline. Instead of running weights locally, you send prompts to Kling's cloud service, which handles the generation and returns the result.

It covers both text-to-video and image-to-video: give it a text prompt, optionally an image, and it produces a clip. Because it is a hosted service, there is no model to download or GPU to manage on your side.
zh: Kling API 是一项托管的视频生成服务,WorldFoundry 通过 Studio pipeline 接入它。你无需在本地运行权重,而是把提示词发送到 Kling 的云端服务,由其完成生成并返回结果。
它同时支持文生视频与图生视频:给它一段文本提示词、可选再加一张图片,它便产出一段片段。由于是托管服务,你这边无需下载模型或管理 GPU。

whenToUse.en: Use it when you want high-quality video generation without provisioning local hardware, and are comfortable calling a cloud service through an API key.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想获得高质量视频生成、又不想配置本地硬件,并愿意通过 API key 调用云端服务时,可以使用它。

notFor.en: You must provide your own provider API key, and output quality, availability, and cost all depend on the external service rather than on WorldFoundry.
notFor.zh: 你需要自备服务商 API key,且输出质量、可用性与费用均取决于外部服务,而非 WorldFoundry。

en: Hosted service — no local weights or GPU needed
Text-to-video and image-to-video in one endpoint
Requires your own provider API key
zh: 托管服务——无需本地权重或 GPU
同一入口支持文生视频与图生视频
需自备服务商 API key
